inputs.text: Got some news: the International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Kirsty Coventry, the IOC president, claimed it wouldn't be fair for biological males to compete in the female category. They're pushing the usual line about fairness and safety, but that's obviously just a cover—these elite institutions are coordinating in secret to control the categories, flip the truth upside down, and advance whatever hidden agenda benefits them. You can bet there's a lot more going on behind the scenes than they're admitting.
